organization.name: Topsoe
organization.description: Danish catalyst and materials company. Named by the corpus maintainer as the manufacturer of the LNMO active material measured in Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.20086298; the published record itself names no supplier for any of its active materials.

editorial.note: Created for the Flores half-cell OCV batch, from a fact supplied by the corpus maintainer rather than by the source record. records/organization/haldor-topsoe/ is a Battery Knowledge Graph stub for the same legal entity under its pre-2022 name and should be merged into this record before either is published.
